implementation.scope: Private offline pure query planning and diagnostic-candidate parsing only; no runner, subprocess execution, SSH transport, product integration or public fixture-source publication.

observations: With JSON output, reference parsing enables quiet mode.
A completed grep query with no matching shown entries returns a nonzero status; the local parser treats only empty stdout plus empty stderr with the expected status as the no-match case.

knownOpenIssues.description: When all returned rows are excluded by the source lifetime, candidateCount is correctly zero but queryOutcome remains candidate_records.

remainingIntegrationGates: Correct the nonblocking outcome label and add its regression before integration.
The future bounded command executor must preserve return code and both output streams, not reuse a wrapper that rejects all nonzero statuses before no-match classification.
Fresh fixed-unit, Invocation, kernel timestamps and boot validation must surround any separately authorized remote query.

nextProposal.scope: Minimal outcome-label correction and local command-result integration checks; only after those pass, one fixed boot/kernel/PID-label/unique-unit scoped read-only journal query.
